verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ بَنِي نُوحٍ: سَامٌ وَحَامٌ وَيَافَثُ. وَوُلِدَ لَهُمْ بَنُونَ بَعْدَ ٱلطُّوفَانِ.
verses.kjv: Now these [are] the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

verses.ar: بَنُو يَافَثَ: جُومَرُ وَمَاجُوجُ وَمَادَاي وَيَاوَانُ وَتُوبَالُ وَمَاشِكُ وَتِيرَاسُ.
verses.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.web: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو جُومَرَ: أَشْكَنَازُ وَرِيفَاثُ وَتُوجَرْمَةُ.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.web: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو يَاوَانَ: أَلِيشَةُ وَتَرْشِيشُ وَكِتِّيمُ وَدُودَانِيمُ.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.web: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.ar: مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ تَفَرَّقَتْ جَزَائِرُ ٱلْأُمَمِ بِأَرَاضِيهِمْ، كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ كَلِسَانِهِ حَسَبَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ بِأُمَمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو حَامٍ: كُوشُ وَمِصْرَايِمُ وَفُوطُ وَكَنْعَانُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.web: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو كُوشَ: سَبَا وَحَوِيلَةُ وَسَبْتَةُ وَرَعْمَةُ وَسَبْتَكَا. وَبَنُو رَعْمَةَ: شَبَا وَدَدَانُ.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.ar: وَكُوشُ وَلَدَ نِمْرُودَ ٱلَّذِي ٱبْتَدَأَ يَكُونُ جَبَّارًا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي كَانَ جَبَّارَ صَيْدٍ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ. لِذَلِكَ يُقَالُ: «كَنِمْرُودَ جَبَّارُ صَيْدٍ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.web: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱبْتِدَاءُ مَمْلَكَتِهِ بَابِلَ وَأَرَكَ وَأَكَّدَ وَكَلْنَةَ، فِي أَرْضِ شِنْعَارَ.
verses.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.ar: مِنْ تِلْكَ ٱلْأَرْضِ خَرَجَ أَشُّورُ وَبَنَى نِينَوَى وَرَحُوبُوتَ عَيْرَ وَكَالَحَ
verses.kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.web: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

verses.ar: وَرَسَنَ، بَيْنَ نِينَوَى وَكَالَحَ، هِيَ ٱلْمَدِينَةُ ٱلْكَبِيرَةُ.
verses.kjv: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same [is] a great city.
verses.web: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

verses.ar: وَمِصْرَايِمُ وَلَدَ: لُودِيمَ وَعَنَامِيمَ وَلَهَابِيمَ وَنَفْتُوحِيمَ
verses.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

verses.ar: وَفَتْرُوسِيمَ وَكَسْلُوحِيمَ. ٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجَ مِنْهُمْ فِلِشْتِيمُ وَكَفْتُورِيمُ.
verses.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

verses.ar: وَكَنْعَانُ وَلَدَ: صِيْدُونَ بِكْرَهُ، وَحِثًّا
verses.kjv: ¶ And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.web: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

verses.ar: وَٱلْيَبُوسِيَّ وَٱلْأَمُورِيَّ وَٱلْجِرْجَاشِيَّ
verses.kjv: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.web: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

verses.ar: وَٱلْحِوِّيَّ وَٱلْعَرْقِيَّ وَٱلسِّينِيَّ
verses.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.web: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْوَادِيَّ وَٱلصَّمَارِيَّ وَٱلْحَمَاتِيَّ. وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ تَفَرَّقَتْ قَبَائِلُ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّ.
verses.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.web: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ تُخُومُ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّ مِنْ صَيْدُونَ، حِينَمَا تَجِيءُ نَحْوَ جَرَارَ إِلَى غَزَّةَ، وَحِينَمَا تَجِيءُ نَحْوَ سَدُومَ وَعَمُورَةَ وَأَدْمَةَ وَصَبُويِيمَ إِلَى لَاشَعَ.
verses.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو حَامٍ حَسَبَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ كَأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ بِأَرَاضِيهِمْ وَأُمَمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, [and] in their nations.
verses.web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

verses.ar: وَسَامٌ أَبُو كُلِّ بَنِي عَابِرَ، أَخُو يَافَثَ ٱلْكَبِيرُ، وُلِدَ لَهُ أَيْضًا بَنُونَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were [children] born.
verses.web: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

verses.ar: بَنُو سَامٍ: عِيلَامُ وَأَشُّورُ وَأَرْفَكْشَادُ وَلُودُ وَأَرَامُ.
verses.kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.web: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو أَرَامَ: عُوصُ وَحُولُ وَجَاثَرُ وَمَاشُ.
verses.kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.web: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.ar: وَأَرْفَكْشَادُ وَلَدَ شَالَحَ، وَشَالَحُ وَلَدَ عَابِرَ.
verses.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

verses.ar: وَلِعَابِرَ وُلِدَ ٱبْنَانِ: ٱسْمُ ٱلْوَاحِدِ فَالَجُ لِأَنَّ فِي أَيَّامِهِ قُسِمَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ. وَٱسْمُ أَخِيهِ يَقْطَانُ.
verses.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one [was] Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name [was] Joktan.
verses.web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.ar: وَيَقْطَانُ وَلَدَ: أَلْمُودَادَ وَشَالَفَ وَحَضَرْمَوْتَ وَيَارَحَ
verses.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.ar: وَهَدُورَامَ وَأُوزَالَ وَدِقْلَةَ
verses.kjv: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.ar: وَعُوبَالَ وَأَبِيمَايِلَ وَشَبَا
verses.kjv: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.web: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.ar: وَأُوفِيرَ وَحَوِيلَةَ وَيُوبَابَ. جَمِيعُ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو يَقْطَانَ.
verses.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these [were] the sons of Joktan.
verses.web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ مَسْكَنُهُمْ مِنْ مِيشَا حِينَمَا تَجِيءُ نَحْوَ سَفَارَ جَبَلِ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ.
verses.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو سَامٍ حَسَبَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ كَأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ بِأَرَاضِيهِمْ حَسَبَ أُمَمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.web: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ قَبَائِلُ بَنِي نُوحٍ حَسَبَ مَوَالِيدِهِمْ بِأُمَمِهِمْ. وَمِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ تَفَرَّقَتِ ٱلْأُمَمُ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ ٱلطُّوفَانِ.
verses.kjv: These [are] the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.web: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
